# Genex UK Ltd

> Family-run UK manufacturer in Walsall, West Midlands. Designs and builds press tools in-house and runs medium-to-high volume metal pressings (0.5–3.0 mm), plus laser cutting (to 25 mm), CNC folding, machining, projection/spot/MIG/TIG welding, assembly and managed finishing (e-coat, zinc, powder). PPAP Level 3 as standard. Builds progressive stamping dies for export and supplies automotive & EV Tier 1s, vehicle start-ups (prototype to production), aerospace, defence, construction, medical and consumer manufacturers in the UK, Europe and North America. Independent since a 2001 management buyout; roots in the 1980s.

## Key pages
- [Press tool design, build & pressings](https://genexuk.co.uk/press-tooling.html): tool types, materials, volumes, lead times (tooling 12–17 weeks), RFQ-to-PPAP process
- [Capabilities](https://genexuk.co.uk/capabilities.html): laser cut & fold, machining, welding, assembly, finishing
- [Industries](https://genexuk.co.uk/industries.html): automotive & EV, aerospace, defence, construction, medical, consumer
- [Quality & PPAP](https://genexuk.co.uk/quality.html): PPAP elements, APQP launch, certification
- [Global supply](https://genexuk.co.uk/global.html): Incoterms, currencies, export documentation, tool export
- [Pressing design guide](https://genexuk.co.uk/pressing-design-guide.html): tooling route by volume, hole/bend design rules, materials, tool cost drivers, PPAP levels
- [Progressive dies built in the UK for export](https://genexuk.co.uk/export-dies.html): stamping dies designed to the customer's press data, built and proven in Walsall with sample parts, shipped to run in press shops in the US, Canada, Mexico and the EU; die build typically 12–17 weeks
- [Request a quote](https://genexuk.co.uk/rfq.html): upload STEP/DXF/PDF; engineer reply within one working day
